title: Coordinate Uncertainty and Error Regions
negative_results: a region collapsed to a point (zero area) without justification is refused as invented precision
a negative input sigma is refused
a non-positive cell size is refused
an out-of-range centre latitude is refused

claims.statement: Quantization (step/sqrt(12)) and input sigma propagate into circular, elliptical, or cell-polygon error regions, each carrying an area and a search-space count; region area scales with sigma (POWER).
A vector->map decode without calibration returns a region or heatmap, never invented precision; a point-sized region requires an explicit justification.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
